title: Allow a load-bearing wall to form before proof loading
statement: Introduced Ys(t)=200(1-exp(-kt)) reaches165N/m after174.297/17.4297/1.74297s at k.01/.1/1 per second; no real kinetics/readiness witness is supplied. In a separate viscosity-only long cavity,2mu_external*d(log r)/dt=DeltaP;60Pa s at20kPa gives .000571861s to10% radius growth. This excludes elasticity, yield stress, jamming, geometric restraint and active support. Laplace scale120Pa is likewise not a real film rupture criterion.
